t: Star Trek - You Can't Do More By Playing It Safe

q.x: One of my favorite episodes of TNG was Tapestry, to the point that it significantly influenced my life perspective. It emphasizes that even in this sort of idealized world, the things you might want to avoid are still unavoidable. [1] [1] - [link]
